messages:
Priya (Marketing): Heads up  Nimbus wants a coordinated marketplace + webinar push next week. Need: launch blog, benchmark narrative, webinar landing, and clear lead routing. Quick callout  who picks what?
Eli (Demand Gen): Ill take landing + registration flow + UTMs. Need speaker list by Friday EOD to finalize promo cadence.
Samir (Partnerships): I'll lock speakers with Nimbus PM and our PM. Asking Nimbus comms for a one-sentence partner quote for the blog.
Jordan (Product Marketing): I'll draft the benchmark narrative. Proposal: call out embeddings throughput for batch workloads and chat p95 latency; include cost-per-1k tokens and an accuracy check on a small intent set.
Leah (Solutions): Ill produce two short integration demos (30s feature clip, 90s walkthrough) showing marketplace provisioning -> private deploy. Also can create a short script for the webinar demo.
Priya (Marketing): Eli  please use this UTM scheme: partner=nimbus, campaign=marketplace_co_launch, channel=webinar. Also tag content param for ad variants.
Eli (Demand Gen): UTM snippet:
```
utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=marketplace_co_launch&utm_content=registration_cta
```
HubSpot form id: 5f2a-landing-nimbus
Samir (Partnerships): Lead routing ask from Nimbus: route leads with ARR >=50k to Nimbus AEs (co-sell); others to our demo queue. Can HubSpot do conditional assignment?
hubspot-bot: Workflow created: "nimbus_inbound_v1" (wf_9933). Trigger: form_submission -> evaluate_hidden_arr -> assign_owner
Eli (Demand Gen): Yep hidden ARR field + workflow will work. Leah  what's the demo queue tag taxonomy?
Leah (Solutions): Use tags: demo.type=integration; demo.source=marketplace; priority=standard. I'll add the exact tags to the shared sheet.
Jordan (Product Marketing): For the benchmark I need p95 latency (us-west2) at 512 tokens, cost/1k tokens, error/retry rate for a 24h run. Eng, can we get these logs by tonight?
Samir (Partnerships): Nimbus legal requests blog signoff within 48h of draft. Priya, can you own the partner approval path?
Priya (Marketing): I will. Also drafting a short partner quote option: "Redwood + Nimbus: dependable, lower-cost inference at scale." Samir, confirm with them.
Eli (Demand Gen): Webinar structure: 30 min total (18 demo, 9 Q&A, 3 CTAs). CTA: pick a demo preference -> nurture track. I'll build mid-funnel journey.
Leah (Solutions): Scripting notes dropping in doc tonight. Rehearsal Thursday morning works for me.
Priya (Marketing): Launch checklist:
1) Blog + partner quote (Jordan draft, Samir coordinate)
2) Landing + UTMs + form (Eli)
3) Demo clips + webinar script (Leah)
4) Benchmark data (Eng -> Jordan)
5) HubSpot workflows (Eli/hubspot-bot)
6) Legal/partner approvals (Priya/Samir)
Samir (Partnerships): Timeline check: publish blog + landing Monday morning, webinar Tuesday noon. Partner amplification window ~24h. OK?
Eli (Demand Gen): Tight but doable if eng delivers numbers tonight. Ill stand up the landing and ad copy skeleton: https://go.redwood/marketing/nimbus-orch
Jordan (Product Marketing): Also including a short regression test: two prompt sets for quality checks; will wire into the benchmark doc.
Priya (Marketing): Everyone drop a 1-line status here by EOD, Ill compile the launch brief and ping Nimbus.
Leah (Solutions): status: demo bullets in drive, recording plan set.
Samir (Partnerships): status: speakers confirmed pending timezone, legal pinged.
Eli (Demand Gen): status: landing skeleton live, UTMs in, HubSpot form ready.
Jordan (Product Marketing): status: benchmark/blog outline ready, awaiting p95/cost data.
Priya (Marketing): status: approvals flow created, partner quote requested.
hubspot-bot: New form submissions will be logged to the CRM and trigger wf_9933 as configured.
Priya (Marketing): Thanks team :tada:  will collate and share final brief by 8pm.
